reviews.title: Locked Out of My Own Account
reviews.text:
After installing BiP on my iPad, the app automatically logged me out of my iPhone. Since then, I have been completely unable to sign back in.

Every single login attempt instantly returns the message: “Too many verification codes have been requested. Please try again later.” The problem is that I already waited more than 24 hours between attempts. In fact, this message appears on the very first attempt, before any SMS is even sent.

I deleted the app from my iPad, reinstalled it on my iPhone, restarted the phone, waited for days, and nothing changed.

Your server locked me out of my own account, and there is no way to recover access. No countdown, no explanation, no self-service recovery, no useful support.

This is unacceptable for a messaging app. If users can lose access to their accounts simply by installing the app on another device, your authentication system is fundamentally broken.

One star until this is fixed.
